environment.method: Production browser modules in Node Worker API shim; actual event kernel and pinned ngspice WASM. No browser/UI or secure offline claim.

analogEngine.name: ngspice
analogEngine.execution: WebAssembly · isolated Web Worker · fresh instance per run

digitalEngine.name: CircuitBench event logic
digitalEngine.execution: JavaScript · isolated Web Worker · fresh instance per run
digitalEngine.initialization: Combinational logic settles at time zero; flip-flops use their explicit initial state.
digitalEngine.simultaneousInputs: All driver changes at one timestamp resolve together. A rising-edge DFF samples the resulting D input.
digitalEngine.limitations: No setup/hold, metastability, drive strengths, HDL, or analog feedback coupling.
